'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: If I've Senate Once...

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
